text:
emma_sales: Quick ask 1 - tiny biotech NeuraQ wants an extended trial: requesting 20k credits and 75 days to finish a POC. Default is $5k/30d.

jon_dealdesk: Need quick numbers: expected tokens/day and any commitment if POC succeeds? Also region/data restrictions?

li_se: They said ~500k tokens/day during tuning, dropping to ~150k/day. Prefer eu-west-1 hosting. No PHI but sensitive assay summaries. Recommend 7B model + caching.

emma_sales: Sales expect a $8k/mo pilot for 6 months if POC converts (~$48k). Customer ok with DPA and EU control plane.

devsec_bot: System: auto-scan flagged "sensitive-science". Manual review required.

jon_dealdesk: Two options: (A) Approve 20k/75d if signed SOW committing to $8k/mo for 6 months before drawdown, or (B) Approve 10k/45d no commit. Which does sales prefer?

emma_sales: We push A. AE confident. Can legal fast-track SOW?

maria_ops: Ops: any credit >$10k needs billing tag and quota cap. We can enforce region restrictions and alerts.

jon_dealdesk: Conditional approval: grant 20,000 credits scoped to eu-west-1, expiry 2025-01-15 (75 days), conditions: signed SOW with $8k/mo commit prior to drawdown, security signoff, billing tag "neuraq-poc-2025". Approve?

devsec_bot: System: manual reviewer @rahul_security added.

jon_dealdesk: No objections noted. I'll mark as pending docs.

maria_ops: Once SOW countersigned ops will apply credits and quota cap at $20k.

emma_sales: Uploaded SOW link. Legal looped. Customer demo Tuesday, please expedite.

devsec_bot: System: grant job queued. Job ID: grant-1940000000-01.

maria_ops: Grant executed after countersign. Credits applied: 20000. Expiry: 2025-01-15. Billing tag: neuraq-poc-2025. Quota cap and eu-west-1 enforced.

emma_sales: Thanks team! Demo confirmed. I'll follow up with pilot outcomes later. :raised_hands:
